Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop application UI concept presentation for an existing Windows 11 WPF utility.
Primary request: Design a polished and realistically implementable redesign of EousGate within the existing EousAssistant / Eous 助手 utility suite. Render one landscape design board, approximately 1600x1000, with a large settings-center window taking about 72% width and a separate temporary file opening panel at the right taking about 25%. Both interfaces should be large, crisp and readable; not tiny collage thumbnails. Entire windows visible, front-on flat screenshot, no perspective, no devices or photography. This is a desktop tool, no website marketing hero.
Product truth: files dragged to a screen edge open a temporary single-column list of locally installed software. Multiple TXT files are shown only as "2 个 TXT 文件", never filenames or paths. Four software choices: 记事本, Visual Studio Code, Microsoft Word, 写字板. First choice selected. Footer "松开以打开" and "Esc 取消". Do not include typing search in this drag panel, cloud upload, AI chat, recent file history, fabricated metrics or automatic startup.
Settings center screen: "面板外观". App brand "Eous 助手" with small "EousAssistant". Navigation includes "工具概览", "面板外观" selected, "触发与接收", "剪贴板链接", "软件选项", "辅助与隐私". Small tool identities EousGate and FolderHop may appear in tool grouping. Main appearance settings have three genuinely different small selectable structural thumbnails named "浮动命令", "紧凑列表", "图标网格"; first selected. Theme control has "跟随系统", "浅色", "深色"; material "Mica" and animation duration "160 ms". Preview should correspond to the chosen single-column structure. Bottom footer in exact order left "恢复默认", "帮助"; right "取消", "应用", "保存"; only Save is primary.
Visual requirements: Windows-native minimize, maximize, close window controls top right, no macOS traffic-light dots. Segoe UI Variable and Microsoft YaHei UI-like sans serif Chinese typography, restrained weights, clear 3-level text hierarchy, small familiar line icons, authentic recognizable software icons where feasible. Strong readable body contrast. Keyboard focus and selection visible. 8px-based spacing, mostly 8px corner radii, subtle border and realistic subdued elevation. Not every heading blue. A tiny blue/teal/green brand detail is allowed but no full-page gradient. Chinese copy should be short and accurately rendered. No unnecessary statistics, lorem ipsum, huge decorations or repeated headings. Light neutral board background or coordinated dark board. Full finished visual proposal, not wireframe.

Design direction A — Native Fluent / 原生 Fluent.
Board label top left "A / 原生 Fluent" with small subtitle "清晰 · 熟悉 · 轻量".
Soft cool-white and pale-gray Windows Mica main window, white solid content cards, cobalt blue #2563EB used only for selected indicators and primary action, foreground #172033. Narrow 184px left navigation, clean compact title bar. Main content has page title and a short explanation at top, then a TWO-COLUMN appearance editor: left controls with three small horizontal style thumbnails across one row, theme segmented control and material rows beneath; right embedded live preview on a subtle pale gray desktop surface. A small "实时预览" label. Keep the controls all comfortably above footer, no gigantic cards or broad wasted blank area. Separate opening panel at right is compact floating acrylic, 4 clear horizontal software rows around 52px each, selected row pale blue with subtle left accent and a visible arrow, very soft shadow. Tiny tricolor line on top only. Refined, quiet, precise, production-quality Windows utility design. Small board captions only beneath windows, no explanatory essay.

Design direction B — Focus Console / 深色效率.
Board label top left "B / 深色效率" with small subtitle "紧凑 · 专注 · 快速扫描".
Warm-neutral charcoal #17191D, surface #22252A, elevated #2B2F35, strong off-white #F0F2F4 text, muted gray still readable. Restrained mint #80D8C4 accent for selected state and save, near-black text on mint. No purple, neon glow or hacker aesthetic. STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE from A: thin left navigation with compact rows, central content as a vertical settings table with horizontal labeled rows and inline controls, right-hand preview inspector inside settings window with subtle divider; the three layout choices are compact vertically stacked radio rows each with a distinctly different tiny layout diagram. Smaller but comfortably readable spacing; controls aligned on a single vertical axis, clear content rhythm rather than many floating cards. Top has quiet breadcrumb "EousGate / 面板外观", then title. Footer compact and precise. Separate temporary opening panel at right: dark acrylic, short single-line app names with secondary metadata only where useful, selected row muted mint-tinted, neatly aligned arrow and software count. No extra search field or keyboard number shortcuts. Sharply readable professional command palette refinement.

Design direction C — Quiet Studio / 暖白工作室.
Board label top left "C / 暖白工作室" with small subtitle "温润 · 直观 · 预览优先".
Warm ivory #F5F2EC board and window background, solid off-white #FFFDF8 cards, dark ink #25312E, muted deep sage-teal #286B5E accent, refined neutral hairline borders. No orange CTA, no paper texture, no decorative plants or photography. STRUCTURAL DIFFERENCE from A and B: slim left icon-and-text navigation, broad PREVIEW-FIRST composition inside settings: a large desktop-preview canvas takes the left 60% of the content area, and a neatly separated narrow parameter inspector takes the right 40%, with layout selector made of three compact structural preview tiles, then theme and material controls stacked underneath. No giant marketing headline. Preview canvas shows the edge reception strip along its left boundary and a floating single-column panel to explain file dragging intuitively; small two-file stack icon, no filenames. Keep title "面板外观" modest, workspace calm and information balanced. Footer exact action order. Separate enlarged opening panel at right uses warm ivory solid/acrylic surface, gently rounded rectangular app rows, dark text and sage selected row, crisp recognizable icons and readable metadata. Elegant tactile desktop utility, realistic WPF controls, restrained visual warmth.
